split_tensor_along_last_dim: split a PyTorch tensor into equal partitions along its last dimension for model parallelism
ensure_divisibility: assert that a numerator is evenly divisible by a given denominator and raise on failure
divide_and_check_no_remainder: divide a numerator by a denominator after asserting the division has no remainder
vocab_range_from_global_vocab_size: compute the start and end vocabulary index range for a given rank in model parallel training
vocab_range_from_per_partition_vocab_siz: compute the start and end vocabulary index range from a per-partition vocab size and rank
